text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with Urinary Tract Involvement. The clinical picture of fever, uterine tenderness, foul-smelling discharge, and urinary frequency following a prolonged labor is classic for endometritis. The urinalysis will help confirm if there is a concurrent UTI, but the primary diagnosis is an uterine infection requiring antibiotic treatment.
